name: Bun oc
summary: Bún ốc is snail rice vermicelli. The Hanoi bowl comes with beef, crab meat, and a plate of herbs, in a broth sharpened with tomatoes, wine vinegar, and pepper.
origin: Hanoi. Vung Tau cooks its own version.
howToEat: Rice vermicelli, beef, crab meat, and a plate of herbs, in a broth of tomatoes, wine vinegar, and pepper.
In Vung Tau the bowl is fresh snails in a sour tomato and tamarind broth, with soft noodles and greens. Add mắm tôm, chili, and herbs to taste. It is breakfast or a light dinner there.
where: In Hanoi, the bowl is snail rice vermicelli with beef, crab meat, and herbs.
In Vung Tau, on Trương Công Định.
priceBand: Check on arrival for the Hanoi bowl. Vung Tau bowl 40,000–65,000 VND (Vietnam Airlines).
seoDescription: Bún ốc in Hanoi is snail rice vermicelli with beef, crab meat, and herbs, in a broth of tomatoes, wine vinegar, and pepper.
